_comment: The declared source is fetchable and the package is popular, but the bytes it serves are NOT the bytes shipped - the packaged copy has an extra line. So verifyUrl returns 'modified' and vendor-modified rejects the submission: a vendored file must be the upstream release exactly, or the review cannot stand on the upstream's behalf. This is the only fixture that reaches the 'modified' outcome. The upstream bytes here are literal (body), because the difference IS the point - contrast verified-vendor-source, which serves the packaged bytes back (sameAs).
